one second before violation N wait at 200s limit still red
detector_fail E active EW green held N wait 58s starting starvation period

counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event (events: [] instead of E fail at t=203); same steps/seed/timings. With normal detection the controller cycles EW/NS and NS wait stays ~17s, no max_wait violation, proving the failure depends on the detector_fail + actuated max_green/recall interaction.

explanation: Shrunk actuated intersection with detector_fail E from t=203 (duration 159) starves NS. EW green starts at ~148 and is held continuously through step 346 (>190s, exceeding max_green_seconds=87) despite large NS queues. The failed E detector makes EW appear partly empty (E queue 0) but W still queued, so actuated gap-out logic never sees EW empty, and max_green / wait-recall logic fails to force a switch (likely treats failed detector as suppressing recall). NS waits grow from 58s at failure start to 200s at step 345 and 201s at step 346, violating max_wait. Removing the detector_fail restores normal cycling and no violation.

violation.detail: approach 0 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: Across steps 343-346 the red violating vehicles queued on the N/S approaches remain stopped at red without moving into or through the intersection. Their positions are unchanged frame to frame, showing the NS direction is continuously held at red while queued.
